source_datasets.citation: Project-assembled post-2004 Poland Catholic diocese layer from OpenStreetMap religious-administration boundaries and Eurostat/GISCO LAU 2024 gmina geometry.

source_datasets.notes: The 41-diocese boundary layer mixes 24 OpenStreetMap religious administration anchor polygons, attributed to © OpenStreetMap contributors under the Open Database Licence (ODbL), with 17 polygons digitised from Eurostat/GISCO Local Administrative Units 2024 gmina geometry. The digitisation method is gmina_digitisation_from_GISCO_LAU_2024 with Wikipedia deanery evidence; authoritative GIS-Expert/KUL polygons remain pending.

indicators.label: Mass attendance (dominicantes), % of obliged Catholics
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary field slot used for dominicantes. This value is a counts-based Mass-attendance rate over obligati, never affiliation, and never a population share.
indicators.method: ISKK dominicantes: persons physically present at Sunday Mass on the annual count Sunday divided by obligati.
indicators.temporal_coverage: 2014-2019 and 2021-2024 (2020 no count; 2013 not freely published)
indicators.spatial_coverage: 41 Latin-rite territorial Catholic dioceses in Poland on post-2004 boundaries.
indicators.quality_notes: Rates ship without a count base. ISKK dominicantes and communicantes are counts-based percentages over obligati: Catholics obliged to attend Sunday Mass, excluding children under seven, the sick and infirm, the very elderly, and travellers. ISKK counts one October or November Sunday per year. The 2020 count did not take place because of COVID-19, and 2013 is not freely published.

indicators.label: Communion (communicantes), % of obliged Catholics

indicators.method: ISKK communicantes: persons receiving communion on the annual count Sunday divided by obligati.
indicators.temporal_coverage: 2014-2019 and 2021-2024 (2020 no count; 2013 not freely published)
indicators.spatial_coverage: 41 Latin-rite territorial Catholic dioceses in Poland on post-2004 boundaries.
